working_interpretation: Preserve pride and everyday mutual support
rating_or_other_baseline: Pride PRI1 92.4% favourable; contribution PRI2 95.7% (n=327 each)
coded_comment_evidence: 119 records explicitly value teamwork; 77 value support or respectful treatment in the preserve prompt
proposed_action_for_review: Protect helpful colleagues, approachable support and shared purpose while changing processes
success_measure_and_baseline: Track the same strength items and preserve-prompt themes alongside improvement work
limit: Do not infer that everyone experiences the same culture

working_interpretation: Make recognition more consistent and specific
rating_or_other_baseline: RES4 recognition 72.5% favourable; 34 select 1–2, 56 select Sometimes
coded_comment_evidence: 179 unique records request recognition or performance feedback
proposed_action_for_review: Review criteria, manager feedback habits and access to recognition across roles/branches
success_measure_and_baseline: Baseline RES4; review recognition coverage and subsequent employee perceptions
limit: Recognition/feedback topic is broader than awards; no event-only solution assumed

working_interpretation: Explain and consistently apply people decisions
rating_or_other_baseline: FAI3 consistency 74.6% favourable; FAI5 decision understanding 75.5%
coded_comment_evidence: 113 request fairer/consistent treatment; 73 fairness replies explicitly report no concern
proposed_action_for_review: Clarify promotion, appraisal, opportunity and reward criteria; test whether employees understand them
success_measure_and_baseline: Baseline FAI3/FAI5; document criteria and track understanding/fairness in a comparable pulse
limit: Mixed experiences; coded requests are not proven unfair decisions

working_interpretation: Improve cross-team execution without losing peer support
rating_or_other_baseline: CAM1 within-team support 91.1% favourable vs CAM2 cross-team collaboration 82.3%; 45 rate CAM1 favourable but CAM2 1–3
coded_comment_evidence: 176 request coordination/teamwork changes; role-clarity and handover examples provide context
proposed_action_for_review: Pilot explicit handover ownership, backup contacts and escalation/response expectations
success_measure_and_baseline: Baseline CAM2; pilot handover response/rework measures and ask whether cross-team support improved
limit: Specific process measures require a new operational baseline; social events alone may not address the issue

working_interpretation: Make learning and progression visible, including mid-tenure follow-up
rating_or_other_baseline: OVR2 growth 90.5% favourable overall; 3–5-year group growth mean 4.30/5, n=53
coded_comment_evidence: 143 request career growth/learning across the prompts
proposed_action_for_review: Hold career conversations, clarify progression and pilot role-relevant/cross-functional learning
success_measure_and_baseline: Baseline OVR2 by tenure; track access/completion and perceived usefulness/growth
limit: Intention to stay is not observed turnover; tenure patterns are exploratory and may reflect composition

rating_or_other_baseline: CRE5 leadership acting on feedback 79.8% favourable; HR Communication chosen by 80/327 records
proposed_action_for_review: Publish a concise issues/actions update with an owner, response expectation and progress review
success_measure_and_baseline: Baseline CRE5; track acknowledgement, resolution and employee awareness of action
limit: More messaging alone does not demonstrate listening; no causal link to engagement established

working_interpretation: Verify specific work-condition and treatment concerns promptly
rating_or_other_baseline: High overall ratings do not establish that specific facilities, boundary or respectful-treatment concerns are resolved
coded_comment_evidence: Broad request topics: facilities/tools/staffing 39, workload/boundaries 78, supervision/support 138; these counts are not counts of serious incidents
proposed_action_for_review: Confidentially verify facilities/equipment and respectful-feedback/boundary accounts; resolve verified issues through existing processes
proposed_owner: Administration/IT, HR and relevant business managers
success_measure_and_baseline: Verify conditions, establish an issue log and completion/follow-up measures; no invented incident baseline
limit: Unverified accounts; protect confidentiality, avoid named allegations and do not infer frequency from selected examples
